tools.name: tankful_county_price_guide
tools.description: Read the published kerosene county reference guide for 300, 500 or 1000 litres, with observation date and confidence. May be unavailable. Not a supplier quote or bookable offer.

tools.name: tankful_find_suppliers
tools.description: List up to five public oil suppliers for a Republic of Ireland county and fuel. Distinguishes confirmed coverage from directory coverage. No live stock, prices, delivery promises or contact is requested.

tools.name: tankful_delivery_request_draft
tools.description: Prepare county, fuel, 300–5000 whole litres and timing preferences, then continue on Tankful. Does not send to anyone, create a persisted request, order, reserve, take payment or collect personal details.

tools.name: tankful_national_prices
tools.description: Every county's lowest current published price for 500 litres of kerosene (home heating oil), with the average, cheapest and dearest county and a page to cite. Reference prices, not quotes.

tools.name: tankful_business_fuel_prices
tools.description: Delivered green diesel (marked gas oil) or road diesel prices per litre for 500 and 1,000 litres from Irish oil suppliers that publish them, with the typical and lowest price, weekly medians and a link for businesses to get quotes. HVO prices are not published online in Ireland.

tools.name: tankful_my_orders
tools.description: The signed-in Tankful customer's 10 most recent heating oil orders: litres, oil supplier, status, price, delivery window and delivered litres. Needs the customer to connect their Tankful account (orders:read). Read-only.
